newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE cabinet resigns, premier to form new one.
newsitem.headline: UAE cabinet resigns, premier to form new one.

text.p: The government of the United Arab Emirates resigned on Sunday and President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan asked Prime Minister Sheikh Maktoum bin Rashid al-Maktoum to form a new cabinet, the official news agency WAM said.
The cabinet was formed in November 1990.
The official agency said Sheikh Maktoum "presented the government's resignation" to Sheikh Zaid who asked the prime minister to form a new cabinet.
It gave no other details and it was not immediately clear when the new cabinet would be announced.
